newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Boto debuts at HK$1.40 per share.
newsitem.headline: HK's Boto debuts at HK$1.40 per share.

text.p: Shares of artificial Christmas tree maker Boto International Holdings Ltd made their trading debut at HK$1.40 per share on Monday, compared with their issue price of HK$1.28.
Boto issued 125.4 million new shares at HK$1.28 each in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong and was 12.6 times subscribed.
The company manufacturs Christmas related products, including artifical Christmas tree, plastic ornanments, garlands and other decorative assessories.
It said net proceeds would be used to set up new manufacturing plants to expand production capacity, repay bank borrowings and for general working capitals.
The principal market for the group's production are the United States and Europe.
